text:
alex: Heads-up — finding a parity gap between the REST API and the Node SDK around auth refresh + retries. REST calls auto-retry on 429 and honor Retry-After, SDK returns 401 and doesn't retry.

alex: Repro (super small):
```bash
# REST (works)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}'

# Node SDK (fails with 401 unless I manually refresh token)
await client.generate({model: 'gpt-small', input: 'hi'})
```

alex: Observed behavior: when token rotated in the background (short lived creds), REST endpoint returns 401 -> with Retry-After the infra issues a short window retry and it succeeds. SDK surfaces 401 back to caller immediately.

marie: thanks — which sdk version? do you see any `x-retry-after` headers in the failed response? @sam fyi in case it's client-side interceptor.

alex: SDK v0.9.4. Here's the raw response headers from the failing call: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized`, `x-request-id: abc123`, no `x-retry-after` in the client-facing error. I can see `retry-after` on the gateway logs for the REST path.

sam: hm interesting. the client http layer strips unknown headers by default? also could be our SDK swallowing `Retry-After` because of our error mapping to a custom Error object.

sam: quick check — are you using `client.auth.setToken()` flow or passing an agent that rotates tokens? we recently changed the auth hook shape from `onAuthRefresh()` -> `getAuthToken()` in 0.9.x; there might be a lifecycle gap.

alex: using an auth agent that rotates creds in-process (AWS STS short creds). The REST path uses the raw bearer header, so it benefits from the gateway automatic retry. The SDK seems to error before the HTTP retry policy kicks in.

jordan: filing an infra ticket to confirm gateway headers and retry semantics. can you paste request id from logs? i'll correlate.

alex: request id `abc123`, and I also saw a 307 at one point when the model routed across region which the SDK didn't follow automatically. so two issues: header/retry handling and redirect-follow behavior for region routing.

marie: this is great context. actionable plan: 1) sam to audit SDK http layer to ensure `Retry-After` and 30x are preserved and retried by built-in policies, 2) add tests that simulate rotating bearer tokens + gateway retry, 3) docs note about auth hook shape change.

sam: I can reproduce locally with STS creds. initial hypothesis: our fetch wrapper marks 3xx as non-retriable for safety. will open a small PR to change to safer default (follow 307 for same-host/region redirect) and expose retry hooks.

ci-bot: Ticket RED-3782 created: "SDK: honor gateway Retry-After and 307 redirects; auth refresh lifecycle regression" — assignee: sam.

alex: thanks — if you want I can attach a tiny repro repo. Also noticed a naming drift: REST param is `stream=true` but Node SDK uses `enableStreaming: true` — confusing for customers. might unify in the same PR.

marie: yes please add the naming parity to the PR. we should also add a short migrating note in the changelog.

jordan: once sam has the PR ready i'll run a canary on staging with the rotating creds job.

alex: sounds good. leaving the repro here: https://git.redwood.internal/alex/sdk-auth-repro (private). i'll link after PR. :thumbsup:

sam: will send PR today. thanks for the detailed repro — saved a lot of debugging time.

alex: awesome. follow-up: add an integration test that asserts SDK auto-retries on 401 when Retry-After header present (align with gateway behavior).

marie: assigning follow-ups: changelog note, docs snippet for auth hook, unit + integration tests. i'll add to the sprint board.

jordan: nice catch, alex.

alex: cool, closing the loop here. will post PR link when ready.
